property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee that may revert on being called, the reference C never reverts when making exactly as many external calls as elements in _tos (i.e., it completes successfully), whereas the mutant that uses i<=_tos.length can attempt an out-of-bounds access and therefore may revert for some inputs (specific _tos lengths), so the property is: for all inputs with _tos.length>0, calling transfer returns true (does not revert) when the callee behaves as expected; the mutant can revert for some such inputs.
change_summary: Change the loop condition from i<_tos.length to i<=_tos.length so when _tos has length n the loop attempts an out-of-bounds access and will revert, causing transfer to revert whereas original might have succeeded.
